name: MariaDB Connector/C
packaged_as: Statically linked into libseekdb.so in the pylibseekdb wheel
redistribution: Retain the LGPL-2.1 text and the copyright notice. Connector/C is statically linked into libseekdb.so, so LGPL-2.1 section 6 applies: a distributor must accompany libseekdb with the complete corresponding source of Connector/C (or a written offer for it) and with the materials needed to relink libseekdb with a modified Connector/C, such as the object files or an equivalent build recipe, or otherwise satisfy section 6. Letting the user replace the shipped libseekdb.so with a compatible build is permitted, but does not by itself meet the relink requirement.
